answer.summary: The $63,473.69 "Managed database service – Jun 2026" line on Bluehaven Data Centers invoice BDC/26/1872 was posted to 6350 Software Subscriptions. It belongs in 6340 Cloud & Hosting Services. Bluehaven's default GL is 6340 with default cost centre CC4430, every one of its other 17 invoices from April 2025 to September 2026 went only to 6340, and its earlier lines with this same description (BDC/25/1846 and BDC/25/1853) were coded 6340 on CC4430. Approve the proposed October 2026 reclass (Dr 6340 / Cr 6350, CC4430, $63,473.69); the invoice was paid on 2026-08-03, so only the GL coding needs fixing, not the payment.

evidence.text: Vendor V3505 Bluehaven Data Centers is in the Cloud & hosting category, with default_gl 6340 and default_cc CC4430.
Bluehaven Data Centers' earlier 'Managed database service' lines (BDC/25/1846 dated 2025-06-02 and BDC/25/1853 dated 2025-09-04) were coded 6340 on CC4430.
